title: tscausal: time-symmetric process matrices without selection — what time symmetry forbids and what it does not
description:
A computational study of time-symmetric process matrices (Mrini–Hardy formalism, arXiv:2406.18489) in the regime without pre- or postselection.

Proven here, with certificates rather than numerics alone:

  • Lemma D6. With the global past and future marginalised, every bipartite process of the formalism reduces to a mixture of one-way channels. The facets N1 and N2 of the time-symmetric polytope are therefore never violated, in any dimension. Conversely, once preselection is allowed, the same facets are violated by a process with a perfectly definite causal order. Hence N1 and N2 witness nothing about causal indefiniteness in either regime.
  • Lemma D8. A time-symmetric definite-order process without selection is exactly a Bell scenario on a maximally entangled state, with outcomes and incomes exchanging the usual roles; the quantum-classical gap on the classes cl3–cl6 is CHSH and the Tsirelson bound in relabelled roles.
  • Witness W* ∈ ISO₃: a classical, causally non-separable three-party process without selection, equal to ½(Lugano + its full inversion), violating the published causal inequalities I₁ (15/16) and I₃ (1) of Abbott et al. An implicit precedent (W₃ of Baumeler–Feix–Wolf, arXiv:1403.7333) is documented in RESULTS.md.
  • The Hoffreumon–Woods construction does not transfer as it stands. The Hoffreumon–Woods construction (arXiv:2603.19208) does not lie in the time-symmetric class ISO: it is carried out of the class by the terms J_A'J_C' (forbidden in TF) and J_B1'J_B2' (forbidden in TB). At its own operations, the maximum of Renou's functional over all real ISO processes is certified (dual point plus Cholesky) to be at most 3√2 = 4.24264070, exactly half of the complex value 6√2 — and operational independence is not even required for that bound.

Open, in a checkable form: is there a real ISO process with operational independence, together with operations, giving a value above Renou's real bound of 7.6605? A dimension scan over d = 2, 4, 6, 8 reached only 6.927206, with no growth towards the complex value.

Methodology. Each stage is sealed by a preregistration of predictions, committed separately before the first run of that stage; the SHA-256 of all eight preregistrations are verified automatically. RESULTS.md is generated by a script and never edited by hand. Every estimator passes an anti-vacuum calibration on a problem whose answer is known in advance. Every upper bound comes with a certificate. All deviations and failed tests are listed in the report.

Files. The repository archive at tag v1.0.0, plus rts_gpu_8.npz — the best point found at dimension (8,8,8,8), which is too large for the repository.
